description: This is a Java source file implementing a device backend for a device registry system. The class 'FileBasedDeviceBackend' manages device registration and credentials using file-backed services, providing CRUD operations and integration with external components through asynchronous handlers. It includes annotations for dependency injection and conditional configuration, indicating its role within a larger modular application.

classes.name: FileBasedDeviceBackend
classes.description: A Spring-managed component implementing device backend functionality using file-backed storage. It handles device registration and credentials management with asynchronous operations, supporting CRUD, persistence, and cleanup operations in a modular, dependency-injected environment.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Checks whether a device registration exists for the given tenant and device ID.

methods.name: readDevice
methods.description: Retrieves device information for a specific tenant and device ID, with tracing span support.

methods.name: deleteDevice
methods.description: Deletes a device and its credentials, based on tenant ID, device ID, optional resource version, and tracing span.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a new device registration and sets up empty credentials if creation is successful.

methods.name: updateDevice
methods.description: Updates an existing device registration with new device data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials associated with a specific device, tenant, and credential type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores credentials for a device, verifying device existence beforehand.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Persists registration and credential data to associated files.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads registration and credential data from files into memory.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all device registration and credential data from memory.

methods.name: toStringHelper
methods.description: Creates a string representation helper including services used.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the backend instance.
